description.description: A short (3-5 word) description of the task

prompt.description: The task for the agent to perform. A forked agent already has this conversation: state the goal, what finished looks like as checks the agent can verify (a measurable threshold, not "no bad output"), and paths, links, or IDs to read. Without forked context, the prompt is all it knows.

harness.description: The harness that executes the task. Defaults to letta (a Letta subagent). Set to override the harness that runs the subagent worker (requires the harness to be installed on the computer).

subagent_type.description: A preset from Available Agents (for example recall, or a custom agent). Supply only description and prompt alongside it: the preset determines launch settings and all other optional fields are ignored. Omit subagent_type to configure the launch yourself.

fork_context.description: When creating a Letta Code subagent (without subagent_type), whether to include the full conversation history in the subagent. Cannot be applied to existing agents or threads. Defaults to true for new default Letta agents and external workers; existing agent or conversation targets resume without forking.

model.description: Optional except for new cursor sessions, which require a Cursor model ID (list IDs with `letta model list --worker cursor`). When omitted, Letta subagents inherit the parent's model and other harnesses use their own default model.

agent_id.description: Deploy an existing agent instead of creating a new one. Starts a new conversation with that agent.

conversation_id.description: Resume from an existing conversation. Does NOT require agent_id (conversation IDs are unique and encode the agent).

computer.description: Run the subagent on another connected computer instead of this machine. Prefer a stable device ID or computer name; ephemeral connection IDs are also supported to pin a specific listener. Pass "cloud" to provision a Cloud sandbox for the subagent's conversation. Fails fast if the device is offline or does not support routing. Omit this field to run on the current machine (the default) — only set it when the task specifically needs to run elsewhere.

mcp.description: External coding workers automatically inherit parent MCP discovery. Use this to opt out or advertise a subset; it does not change authorization.

inherit.description: Inherit MCP discovery metadata (default true). Set false to omit the discovery reminder.

servers.description: Optional exact subset of parent MCP server names to advertise. Requires inherit: true.
